question: How do you recover access if you forgot the router's login password?
expected:
Web Management page password:
Restore the modem router to its factory default settings and then set a new password using 1-15 characters.
generated:
1. Reset the modem router to its factory default settings by pressing and holding the WPS/RESET button on the rear panel for 8 seconds until all LEDs turn back on momentarily, then release the button.
2. Once reset, visit http://tplinkmodem.net and log in using the default credentials.
3. Go to Advanced > System Tools > Administration page.
4. Enter a new password in the Account Management section and confirm it.
5. Click Save to apply the new password settings.

question: Why might bandwidth control not work as expected?
expected: To use the bandwidth control feature, you’d better set static IP Address on each computer to be controlled or configure Address reservation on the modem router in order to manage easily.
generated:
The problem indicates that bandwidth control might not be properly configured or the settings are not effectively applied.

1. Ensure that static IP addresses are set for each computer or configure address reservation on the modem router to manage bandwidth control effectively.
2. Verify that the total upstream and downstream bandwidth values entered match those provided by your ISP.
3. Check that controlling rules are correctly added for each computer, specifying the correct IP address or IP range.
4. Confirm that the bandwidth control feature is enabled and the correct line type (DSL) is selected.

question: How can you remotely access USB storage connected to the router?
expected: You can access your USB disk outside the local area network. For example: Share photos and other large files with your friends without logging in to (and paying for) a photo-sharing site or email system. Get a safe backup for the materials for a presentation. Remove the files on your camera’s memory card from time to time during the journey. Note: If your ISP assigns a private WAN IP address (such as 192.168.x.x or 10.x.x.x), you cannot use this feature because private addresses are not routed on the Internet. Now different clients with Internet connection can access the USB disk: Computer • To download, open a web browser and type the server address ftp://<WAN IP address of the modem router>:<port number> (such as ftp:// 59.40.2.243:21) or ftp://<domain name of the modem router>:<port number> (such as ftp:// MyDomainName:21) in the address bar, then press Enter on the keyboard. • To upload, use a third-party app for network files management. Pad • Use a third-party app for network files management.
generated:
1. Connect your USB storage device to the modem router's USB port and wait for the USB LED to become solid.

2. Visit http://tplinkmodem.net and log in with the password you set for the modem router.

3. Select Advanced > USB Settings > Sharing Access.

4. Enable FTP(via Internet) by selecting the check box and clicking Save.

5. Access the USB disk remotely by opening a web browser and typing the server address ftp://<WAN IP address of the modem router>:<port number> or ftp://<domain name of the modem router>:<port number> in the address bar, then press Enter.
